payload.title: Input guardrails fail open on missing, failing, or unparseable validation

location.anchor: <input_guardrails> table row: `Script missing, non-zero exit, or unparseable output | Continue — fail-open`

payload.description: The autonomous skill explicitly continues execution when the guardrails orchestrator is missing, exits non-zero, or returns unparseable output. Because the guarded input is the user's invocation prompt/args and this skill has write, execute, web, and agent-spawn capabilities, an attacker only needs to trigger a validator error condition to bypass the intended pre-execution policy check and proceed into privileged workflow execution.
payload.impact: Malicious or policy-blocked prompts can bypass the guardrail layer entirely, undermining injection and abuse controls before the agent runs commands or writes files.
payload.recommendation: Fail closed for missing/unparseable/non-zero guardrail results, or at minimum fail closed for non-zero/unparseable outputs except a narrowly defined allowlisted infrastructure outage mode requiring explicit human approval.

payload.title: Workspace cleanup continues after unexpected failures

location.anchor: Phase 0.0 case `*) # Other error - log and continue`

payload.description: Phase 0 only halts cleanup on exit code 3 or detected partial archive state, but any other cleanup failure is logged and the workflow continues. Cleanup is part of the security-critical preflight that archives prior-cycle artifacts and detects partial state; unexpected failures may leave stale artifacts, unsafe state, or prior context in place before subsequent autonomous phases execute.
payload.impact: This weakens isolation between runs and can lead to information disclosure or contaminated execution context if cleanup fails for reasons other than the single security-validation exit code.
payload.recommendation: Treat unexpected cleanup failures as blocking unless the failure mode is explicitly classified as safe. If continuity is required, require a structured cleanup result proving no partial or unsafe state remains before continuing.
